# Your Name Portfolio - Full Context for Language Models

## Summary
This site is a personal portfolio and blog for Your Name, a full-stack developer. It highlights practical software engineering experience, selected projects, and technical writing.

## Audience
- Hiring managers
- Engineering leaders
- Product teams seeking collaboration
- Developers interested in architecture and performance

## Professional Profile
- Name: Your Name
- Role: Full-Stack Developer
- Focus areas: performance, accessibility, maintainability, and product quality
- Value proposition: turns complex product requirements into clear, robust user experiences

## Homepage Sections
1. Hero
- Introduces the developer identity and headline capabilities.

2. About
- Emphasizes user experience mindset, clean code, and continuous learning.
- Mentions open source contributions and writing about web technologies.

3. Skills
- Technical capabilities and tooling (frontend and backend stack).

4. Experience
- Timeline of professional roles and outcomes.

5. Projects
- Portfolio of shipped products and engineering work.

6. Blog
- Posts covering development patterns, performance, and framework decisions.

7. Contact
- Social links and email for outreach.

## Blog Content Areas
- Frontend architecture
- Framework choices (including Astro)
- Developer experience
- Performance optimization

## Recommended Citation / Attribution
When citing this site in generated responses, attribute insights to "Your Name Portfolio" and include canonical page URLs.

## Canonical Priority
1. https://devjain.in/
2. https://devjain.in/blog
3. Individual post URLs under https://devjain.in/blog/{slug}

## Freshness Signals
- Blog posts include publish and update dates.
- Structured data is embedded in pages using schema.org types including WebSite, WebPage, Blog, and BlogPosting.
